title.zh: 卷五十三 志第二十二: 禮志六
title.raw: 卷五十三 志第二十二: 禮志六 Volume 53 Treatises 23: Rites 6

sentences.zh: 禮志六

translations.literal: Treatise on Rites, Part Six
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on Rites, Part Six

sentences.zh: （嘉儀下）〉

translations.literal: (Auspicious Ceremonies, Part Two)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Auspicious Ceremonies, Part Two)〉

sentences.zh: 皇太后生辰朝賀儀：至日，臣僚入朝，國使至幕，班齊，如常儀。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Court Congratulations on the Empress Dowager's Birthday: On the day, officials enter court; state envoys arrive at the curtain pavilion; ranks are assembled, all as in the usual ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Court Congratulations on the Empress Dowager's Birthday: On the appointed day, officials attend court; envoys arrive at the curtain pavilion; when the ranks are formed, the proceedings follow the usual ceremony.

sentences.zh: 皇太后升殿坐，皇帝東面側坐。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall and is seated; the emperor is seated to the side on the east.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall and takes her seat; the emperor sits to one side on the east.

sentences.zh: 契丹舍人殿上通名，契丹、漢人臣僚，宋使副綴翰林學士班，東西兩洞門入，合班稱賀，班首上殿祝壽，分班引出，皆如正旦之儀。

translations.literal: A Khitan chamberlain on the hall announces names; Khitan and Han officials, with the Song envoy and deputy joining the Hanlin Academician rank, enter through the east and west tunnel gates; they unite ranks and offer congratulations; the rank leader ascends the hall to wish long life; they are dismissed by rank—all as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: A Khitan chamberlain announces names from the dais; Khitan and Han officials, with the Song envoy and deputy placed in the Hanlin Academician formation, enter through the eastern and western tunnel gates, unite in rank to offer congratulations, and the head of the formation ascends to wish long life; they are dismissed by formation—all as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 教坊起居，七拜，契丹、漢人臣僚入，進酒，皆如正旦之儀，唯宣答稱「聖旨」。

translations.literal: The Music Office pays respects with seven bows; Khitan and Han officials enter and present wine—all as on New Year's Day, except the proclamation response is called "Imperial edict."
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office performs the greeting with seven bows; Khitan and Han officials enter and present wine—all as on New Year's Day, except that the proclaimed response is termed "Imperial edict."

sentences.zh: 皇帝降御座，進奉皇太后生辰禮物。

translations.literal: The emperor descends from the imperial seat and presents birthday gifts to the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor leaves the imperial seat and presents birthday gifts to the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 過畢，皇帝殿上再拜，殿下臣僚皆再拜。

translations.literal: When finished, the emperor on the hall performs a double bow again; officials below the hall all perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: When this is finished, the emperor bows twice again from the dais; all officials below bow twice as well.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升御座。

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returns to the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 引臣僚分班出，引中書令、北大王西階上殿，奏契丹臣僚進奉。

translations.literal: Officials are led out by rank; the chief minister and the Grand Prince of the North are led up the hall by the western steps and report that Khitan officials present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Officials are led out by formation; the chief minister and the Grand Prince of the North ascend the western steps to report that Khitan officials are presenting tribute.

sentences.zh: 次漢人臣僚並諸道進奉。

translations.literal: Next, Han officials and tribute from all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Next come Han officials and tribute from all circuits.

sentences.zh: 控鶴官置擔床，起居，四拜畢；

translations.literal: Crane-Control officers set out carrying couches; they pay respects; when four bows are finished;
translations.idiomatic: Crane-Control officers set out carrying couches and perform the greeting; when four bows are finished;

sentences.zh: 引進使鞠躬，通文武百僚某官某以下，高麗、夏國、諸道進奉。

translations.literal: The Commissioner for Introducing Officials bows and announces: civil and military officials of such-and-such office and below, tribute from Goryeo, Xia, and all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The introducing commissioner bows and announces the civil and military officials from such-and-such office downward, and tribute from Goryeo, Western Xia, and all circuits.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使殿上贊進奉各付所司，控鶴官聲喏。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat on the hall proclaims that each tribute item is delivered to its office; Crane-Control officers cry assent.
translations.idiomatic: On the dais the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat announces that each tribute item is to be delivered to the appropriate office; Crane-Control officers cry assent.

sentences.zh: 擔床過畢，契丹、漢人臣僚以次謝，五拜。

translations.literal: When the carrying couches have passed, Khitan and Han officials thank in order, five bows.
translations.idiomatic: When the carrying couches have passed, Khitan and Han officials thank in turn with five bows.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，引出。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they are led out.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties and are led out.

sentences.zh: 教坊、諸道進奉使謝如之。

translations.literal: The Music Office and circuit tribute envoys thank in the same manner.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office and envoys presenting circuit tribute thank in the same way.

sentences.zh: 契丹臣僚謝宣宴，引上殿就位立，漢人臣僚並宋使副東洞門入，面西謝宣宴，如正旦儀。

translations.literal: Khitan officials thank for the proclaimed banquet; they are led up the hall to take position and stand; Han officials and the Song envoy and deputy enter the east tunnel gate, face west to thank for the proclaimed banquet, as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan officials thank for the proclaimed banquet and are led onto the dais to take their places; Han officials and the Song envoy and deputy enter through the east tunnel gate, face west to thank for the banquet, as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 贊各上殿祗候，臣僚、使副上殿就位立，亦如之。

translations.literal: "Each ascend the hall and attend" is proclaimed; officials and envoys ascend the hall, take position, and stand—also likewise.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to ascend the dais and attend; officials and envoys ascend, take their places, and stand—as before.

sentences.zh: 監盞、教坊上殿，從人入東廊立，皆如之。

translations.literal: Cup-attendants and the Music Office ascend the hall; attendants enter and stand in the east corridor—all likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Cup-attendants and musicians ascend the dais; attendants enter and stand in the eastern corridor—all likewise.

sentences.zh: 御床入，皇帝初進酒，臣僚就位陪拜。

translations.literal: The imperial couch is brought in; the emperor offers wine for the first round; officials take position and bow in accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial couch is brought in; the emperor offers the first round of wine; officials take their places and bow in accompaniment.

sentences.zh: 皇太后飲酒，殿上應坐、侍立臣僚皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager drinks, officials on the hall who are to be seated and those standing in attendance all bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager drinks, officials seated on the dais and those standing in attendance all bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，立。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they stand.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties and remain standing.

sentences.zh: 皇太后卒飲，手賜皇帝酒。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager finishes drinking, she personally bestows wine on the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager finishes her drink, she personally bestows wine on the emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇帝跪，卒飲，退就褥位，再拜，臣僚皆陪拜。

translations.literal: The emperor kneels, finishes drinking, withdraws to his cushion seat, and performs a double bow; all officials bow in accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor kneels, finishes his drink, withdraws to his cushioned place, and bows twice; all officials bow with him.

sentences.zh: 若皇帝親賜使相、臣僚、宋使副酒，皆立飲。

translations.literal: If the emperor personally bestows wine on envoys, chief ministers, officials, or the Song envoy and deputy, they all stand to drink.
translations.idiomatic: If the emperor personally bestows wine on envoys, chief ministers, officials, or the Song envoy and deputy, they all drink standing.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升坐，贊應坐臣僚並使副皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: The emperor ascends and is seated; officials and envoys who are to be seated are acclaimed to bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor takes his seat; officials and envoys who are to be seated are acclaimed to bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 贊各就坐。

translations.literal: "Each take your seat" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to take their seats.

sentences.zh: 行方裀朵殿臣僚酒，如正旦儀。

translations.literal: Wine is served to officials on the square-mat banquet in the Duo Hall, as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Wine is served to officials at the square-mat banquet in the Duo Hall, as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 一進酒，兩廊從人拜，稱「萬歲」，各就坐。

translations.literal: At the first round of wine, attendants in both corridors bow, cry "Ten thousand years!" and each take their seat.
translations.idiomatic: At the first round, attendants in both corridors bow, exclaim "Ten thousand years!" and take their seats.

sentences.zh: 親王進酒，如正旦儀。

translations.literal: A prince presents wine, as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: A prince presents wine, as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 若皇太后手賜親王酒，跪飲訖，退露臺上，五拜。

translations.literal: If the Empress Dowager personally bestows wine on a prince, he kneels to drink; when finished, he withdraws to the exposed terrace above and performs five bows.
translations.idiomatic: If the Empress Dowager personally bestows wine on a prince, he kneels to drink; when finished, he withdraws to the upper terrace and bows five times.

sentences.zh: 贊祗候。

translations.literal: "Attend to duty" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to attend to his duty.

sentences.zh: 殿上三進酒，行餅茶訖，教坊跪，致語，揖臣僚、使副、廊下從人皆立。

translations.literal: On the hall, three rounds of wine are presented; when pastry and tea are finished, the Music Office kneels and delivers formal address; officials, envoys, and corridor attendants are all motioned to stand.
translations.idiomatic: Three rounds of wine are presented on the dais; when pastry and tea are finished, the Music Office kneels and delivers the formal address; officials, envoys, and attendants in the corridors are motioned to stand.

sentences.zh: 口號絕，贊拜亦如之。

translations.literal: When the shouted motto ends, the acclaim to bow is also likewise.
translations.idiomatic: When the shouted motto ends, they are acclaimed to bow in the same way.

sentences.zh: 行茶、行殽膳，皆如之。

translations.literal: Serving tea and serving dishes of food are all likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Serving tea and serving dishes proceed in the same way.

sentences.zh: 大饌入，行粥碗。

translations.literal: The grand feast enters; congee bowls are presented.
translations.idiomatic: The grand feast is brought in; congee bowls are presented.

sentences.zh: 殿上七進酒，使相、臣僚樂曲終，揖廊下從人起，拜，稱「萬歲」、「各好去」，承受官引兩門出。

translations.literal: On the hall, seven rounds of wine; when envoys' and officials' musical pieces end, corridor attendants are motioned to rise, bow, cry "Ten thousand years!" and "Each fare well!"; receiving officers lead them out through both gates.
translations.idiomatic: Seven rounds of wine are presented on the dais; when the musical pieces for envoys and officials end, attendants in the corridors are motioned to rise, bow, and exclaim "Ten thousand years!" and "Farewell, all!"; receiving officers lead them out through both gates.

sentences.zh: 曲破，揖臣僚、使副起，鞠躬。

translations.literal: At the suite break, officials and envoys are motioned to rise and bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: At the suite break, officials and envoys are motioned to rise and bow with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: "Bow" is proclaimed; all bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to bow; all bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，引臣僚、使副下殿。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; officials and envoys are led down from the hall.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties, and officials and envoys are led down from the dais.

sentences.zh: 契丹臣僚謝宴畢，出。

translations.literal: Khitan officials, having thanked for the banquet, go out.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan officials, having thanked for the completion of the banquet, withdraw.

sentences.zh: 漢人臣僚、使副舞蹈，五拜畢，贊「各好去」。

translations.literal: Han officials and the envoy and deputy perform the dancing bow; when five bows are finished, "Each fare well!" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Han officials and the Song envoy and deputy perform the dancing bow; when five bows are finished, they are acclaimed: "Farewell, all!"

sentences.zh: 出洞門畢，報閣門無事，皇太后、皇帝起。

translations.literal: When they have finished exiting the tunnel gate, the gate office reports no remaining business; the Empress Dowager and emperor rise.
translations.idiomatic: When they have finished exiting the tunnel gate, the gate office reports that nothing remains; the Empress Dowager and emperor rise.

sentences.zh: 應聖節，宋遣使來賀生辰、正旦，始制此儀，故詳見《賓儀》。

translations.literal: On the Holy Response festival, when Song dispatched envoys to congratulate on birthdays and New Year's Day, this ceremony was first instituted; details are therefore given in the "Treatise on Guest Ritual."
translations.idiomatic: On the Holy Response festival, when Song first sent envoys to congratulate on birthdays and New Year's Day, this ceremony was instituted; the full account is therefore given in the Treatise on Guest Ritual.

sentences.zh: 凡五拜：拜，興。

translations.literal: As for the five bows: bow, rise.
translations.idiomatic: The five bows consist of: bow, rise;

sentences.zh: 再拜，興。

translations.literal: double bow, rise;
translations.idiomatic: double bow, rise;

sentences.zh: 跪，搢笏，三舞蹈，三叩頭，出笏，就拜，興。

translations.literal: kneel, tuck the tablet, three dancing bows, three kowtows, withdraw the tablet, perform obeisance in place, rise;
translations.idiomatic: kneel and tuck the tablet, perform three dancing bows and three kowtows, withdraw the tablet, bow in place, and rise;

sentences.zh: 拜，興。

translations.literal: bow, rise;
translations.idiomatic: bow, rise;

sentences.zh: 再拜，興。

translations.literal: double bow, rise.
translations.idiomatic: double bow, rise.

sentences.zh: 其就拜，亦曰俯伏興。

translations.literal: The obeisance in place is also called "prostrate and rise."
translations.idiomatic: The bow performed in place is also termed "prostrate and rise."

sentences.zh: 《賓儀》，臣僚皆曰坐，於此儀曰高裀，與方裀別。

translations.literal: In the "Treatise on Guest Ritual," officials are all said to "sit"; in this ceremony they are said to use "high mats," distinct from "square mats."
translations.idiomatic: In the Treatise on Guest Ritual officials are said to "take their seats"; in this ceremony they are said to use "high mats," which differ from square mats.

sentences.zh: 皇帝生辰朝賀儀：臣僚、國使班齊，皇帝升殿坐。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Court Congratulations on the Emperor's Birthday: When officials and state envoys' ranks are assembled, the emperor ascends the hall and is seated.
translations.idiomatic: Court Congratulations on the Emperor's Birthday: When officials and envoys have formed their ranks, the emperor ascends the hall and takes his seat.

sentences.zh: 臣僚、使副入，合班稱賀，合班出，皆如皇太后生辰儀。

translations.literal: Officials and the envoy and deputy enter; they unite ranks and offer congratulations, then unite ranks and go out—all as in the Empress Dowager's birthday ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and the envoy and deputy enter, unite in rank to offer congratulations, then withdraw in formation—all as at the Empress Dowager's birthday.

sentences.zh: 中書令、北大王奏諸道進奉表目。

translations.literal: The chief minister and the Grand Prince of the North report the lists of tribute tables from all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister and the Grand Prince of the North present the lists of tribute memorials from all circuits.

sentences.zh: 教坊起居，七拜。

translations.literal: The Music Office pays respects with seven bows.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office performs the greeting with seven bows.

sentences.zh: 臣僚東西門入，合班再拜。

translations.literal: Officials enter through the east and west gates; they unite ranks and perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Officials enter through the eastern and western gates and unite in rank to bow twice.

sentences.zh: 贊進酒，班首上殿進酒。

translations.literal: "Present wine" is proclaimed; the rank leader ascends the hall and presents wine.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to present wine; the head of the formation ascends the dais and presents wine.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使宣答，群臣謝宣諭，分班。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat proclaims the response; the multitude of officials thank for the proclaimed instruction; they are dismissed by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat proclaims the response; the assembled officials thank for the imperial instruction and are dismissed by formation.

sentences.zh: 奏樂，皇帝卒飲，合班。

translations.literal: Music is played; the emperor finishes drinking; ranks are united.
translations.idiomatic: Music is played; the emperor finishes his drink; the ranks unite.

sentences.zh: 班首下殿，分班出。

translations.literal: The rank leader descends the hall; they are dismissed by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The head of the formation descends from the dais; they withdraw by formation.

sentences.zh: 皆如正旦之儀。

translations.literal: All as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: All proceed as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 進奉皆如皇太后生辰儀。

translations.literal: Presenting tribute is all as in the Empress Dowager's birthday ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The presentation of tribute follows the Empress Dowager's birthday ceremony throughout.

sentences.zh: 皇帝詣皇太后殿，近上皇族、外戚、大臣並從，奉迎太后即皇帝殿坐。

translations.literal: The emperor proceeds to the Empress Dowager's hall; close imperial kin, maternal relatives, and great ministers all follow, escorting the Empress Dowager to the emperor's hall to be seated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor proceeds to the Empress Dowager's hall; close imperial kin, maternal relatives, and senior ministers all accompany him, escorting the Empress Dowager to the emperor's hall to take her seat.

sentences.zh: 皇太后禦小輦，皇帝輦側步從，臣僚分行序引，宣徽使、諸司、閣門攢隊前引。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager mounts a small palanquin; the emperor walks in step beside the palanquin; officials proceed in separate ranks in order; the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, various offices, and the gate office mass their escort and lead ahead.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager rides in a small palanquin; the emperor walks in step beside it; officials proceed in ordered ranks; the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat, the various offices, and the gate office mass their escort and lead the way.

sentences.zh: 教坊動樂，控鶴起居，四拜。

translations.literal: The Music Office sets music in motion; Crane-Control pays respects with four bows.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office strikes up; Crane-Control performs the greeting with four bows.

sentences.zh: 引駕臣僚並於山樓南方立候。

translations.literal: Officials escorting the imperial procession all stand waiting to the south of the mountain pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Officials escorting the imperial procession all stand waiting to the south of the mountain pavilion.

sentences.zh: 皇太后入閣，揖使副並臣僚入幕次。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager enters the side chamber; envoys and officials are motioned into the curtain pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager enters the side chamber; the envoy and deputy and the officials are motioned into the curtain pavilion.

sentences.zh: 皇太后升殿坐，皇帝東方側坐。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall and is seated; the emperor is seated to the side on the east.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall and takes her seat; the emperor sits to one side on the east.

sentences.zh: 引契丹、漢人臣僚、使副兩洞門入，合班，起居，舞蹈五拜。

translations.literal: Khitan and Han officials and the envoy and deputy are led in through both tunnel gates; they unite ranks, pay respects, and perform the dancing bow with five bows.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan and Han officials and the envoy and deputy are led in through both tunnel gates; they unite in rank, perform the greeting, and bow five times in the dancing bow.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，面殿立。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they stand facing the hall.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties and stand facing the dais.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降御坐，殿上立，進皇太后生辰物。

translations.literal: The emperor descends from the imperial seat and stands on the hall to present the Empress Dowager's birthday gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor leaves the imperial seat, stands on the dais, and presents the Empress Dowager's birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 過畢，皇帝殿上再拜，殿上下臣僚皆拜。

translations.literal: When finished, the emperor on the hall performs a double bow again; officials above and below the hall all bow.
translations.idiomatic: When this is finished, the emperor bows twice again from the dais; all officials on and below the dais bow.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升御座，引臣僚分班出。

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the imperial seat; officials are led out by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returns to the imperial seat; officials are led out by formation.

sentences.zh: 契丹臣僚入，謝宣宴。

translations.literal: Khitan officials enter and thank for the proclaimed banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan officials enter and thank for the proclaimed banquet.

sentences.zh: 漢人臣僚、使副入，通名謝宣宴，上殿就位。

translations.literal: Han officials and the envoy and deputy enter; names are announced and they thank for the proclaimed banquet; they ascend the hall and take position.
translations.idiomatic: Han officials and the envoy and deputy enter; their names are announced as they thank for the banquet, then they ascend the dais and take their places.

sentences.zh: 不應坐臣僚出，從人入，皆如儀。

translations.literal: Officials not to be seated go out; attendants enter—all as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who are not to be seated withdraw; attendants enter—all as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 御床入，皇帝初進皇太后酒，皇太后賜皇帝酒，皆如皇太后生辰儀。

translations.literal: The imperial couch is brought in; the emperor offers the Empress Dowager wine for the first round; the Empress Dowager bestows wine on the emperor—all as in the Empress Dowager's birthday ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial couch is brought in; the emperor offers the Empress Dowager the first round of wine, and the Empress Dowager bestows wine on the emperor—all as at the Empress Dowager's birthday.

sentences.zh: 贊各就坐，行酒。

translations.literal: "Each take your seat" is proclaimed; wine is served.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to take their seats, and wine is served.

sentences.zh: 宣飲盡，就位謝如儀。

translations.literal: When it is proclaimed that drinking is finished, they take position and thank as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When drinking is proclaimed finished, they take their places and thank as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 殿上一進酒畢，從人入就位如儀。

translations.literal: When the first round of wine on the hall is finished, attendants enter and take position as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When the first round on the dais is finished, attendants enter and take their places as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 親王進酒，行餅茶，教坊致語如儀。

translations.literal: A prince presents wine; pastry and tea are served; the Music Office delivers formal address as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: A prince presents wine; pastry and tea are served; the Music Office delivers the formal address as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 行茶、行殽膳如儀。

translations.literal: Serving tea and serving dishes of food are as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Tea and dishes are served as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 七進酒，使相樂曲終，從人起。

translations.literal: Seven rounds of wine; when envoys' musical pieces end, attendants rise.
translations.idiomatic: Seven rounds of wine are presented; when the envoys' musical pieces end, attendants rise.

sentences.zh: 曲破，臣僚、使副起。

translations.literal: At the suite break, officials and envoys rise.
translations.idiomatic: At the suite break, officials and envoys rise.

sentences.zh: 餘皆如正旦之儀。

translations.literal: The remainder is all as in the New Year's Day ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Everything else proceeds as on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 皇后生辰儀：臣僚昧爽朝。

translations.literal: Ceremony for the Empress's Birthday: Officials attend court at daybreak.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress's Birthday Ceremony: Officials attend court at daybreak.

sentences.zh: 皇帝、皇后大帳前拜日，契丹、漢人臣僚陪拜。

translations.literal: Before the great tent of the emperor and empress, they bow to the sun; Khitan and Han officials bow in accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: Before the great tent of the emperor and empress, they bow to the sun; Khitan and Han officials bow with them.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升殿坐，皇后再拜，臣僚殿下合班陪拜。

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the hall and is seated; the empress performs a double bow; officials below the hall unite ranks and bow in accompaniment.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascends the hall and takes his seat; the empress bows twice; officials below unite in rank and bow with her.

sentences.zh: 皇帝賜皇后生辰禮物，皇后殿上謝，再拜，臣僚皆拜。

translations.literal: The emperor bestows birthday gifts on the empress; the empress on the hall expresses thanks with a double bow; all officials bow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bestows birthday gifts on the empress; the empress thanks him from the dais with two bows; all officials bow.

sentences.zh: 契丹舍人通名，契丹、漢人臣僚以次入賀。

translations.literal: A Khitan chamberlain announces names; Khitan and Han officials enter in order to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: A Khitan chamberlain announces names; Khitan and Han officials enter in turn to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 盞入，舍人贊，舞蹈，五拜，起居不表「聖躬萬福」。

translations.literal: When the cup enters, the chamberlain proclaims; they perform the dancing bow with five bows; in paying respects they do not declare "May the sacred person enjoy ten thousand blessings."
translations.idiomatic: When the cup is brought in, the chamberlain proclaims; they perform the dancing bow with five bows; in the greeting they do not declare "May His Majesty enjoy ten thousand blessings."

sentences.zh: 贊再拜。

translations.literal: "Double bow" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to bow twice.

sentences.zh: 班首上殿拜跪，自通全銜祝壽訖，引下殿，復位，鞠躬。

translations.literal: The rank leader ascends the hall, bows and kneels, announces his full title himself to wish long life; when finished, he is led down the hall, returns to position, and bows with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: The head of the formation ascends the dais, bows and kneels, announces his full title himself to wish long life; when finished, he is led down, returns to his place, and bows with body bent.

sentences.zh: 贊舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: "Dancing bow" is proclaimed; five bows.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to perform the dancing bow; five bows.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties.

sentences.zh: 引宰臣一員上殿，奏百僚諸道進表目。

translations.literal: One chief minister is led up the hall and reports the lists of memorial tables presented by officials of all ranks and all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: A chief minister is led onto the dais to present the lists of memorials submitted by officials of all ranks and from all circuits.

sentences.zh: 教坊起居，七拜，不賀。

translations.literal: The Music Office pays respects with seven bows; they do not offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office performs the greeting with seven bows but does not offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 控鶴官起居，四拜。

translations.literal: Crane-Control officers pay respects with four bows.
translations.idiomatic: Crane-Control officers perform the greeting with four bows.

sentences.zh: 諸道押衙附奏起居，賜宴，共八拜。

translations.literal: Circuit escort commanders append reports of paying respects; a banquet is bestowed; eight bows in all.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit escort commanders append reports of paying their respects; a banquet is bestowed; eight bows in all.

sentences.zh: 契丹、漢人合班，進壽酒，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: Khitan and Han unite ranks, present longevity wine, perform the dancing bow with five bows.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan and Han officials unite in rank, present longevity wine, and perform the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 引大臣一員上殿，欄外褥搢笏，執臺盞進酒，皇帝、皇后受盞。

translations.literal: One great minister is led up the hall; outside the railing on his cushion he tucks his tablet, holds a pedestal cup, and presents wine; the emperor and empress receive the cups.
translations.idiomatic: A great minister is led onto the dais; on his cushion outside the railing he tucks his tablet, takes up a pedestal cup, and presents wine; the emperor and empress receive the cups.

sentences.zh: 退，復褥位。

translations.literal: He withdraws and returns to his cushion seat.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws and returns to his cushioned place.

sentences.zh: 授臺出笏，欄內拜跪，自通全銜祝壽「臣等謹進千萬歲壽酒」，訖，引下殿，復位，舞蹈，五拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: He hands over the pedestal and withdraws his tablet; inside the railing he bows and kneels, announces his full title himself to wish long life: "Your servants respectfully present wine for ten thousand years of longevity"; when finished, he is led down the hall, returns to position, performs the dancing bow with five bows, and bows with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: He hands over the pedestal and withdraws his tablet; inside the railing he bows and kneels and announces his full title: "Your servants respectfully present wine for ten thousand years of longevity"; when finished, he is led down, returns to his place, performs the dancing bow with five bows, and bows with body bent.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使奏宣答如儀，引上殿，搢笏執臺。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat reports the proclaimed response as in the ceremony; he is led up the hall, tucks his tablet, and holds the pedestal.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat reports the imperial response as prescribed; he is led onto the dais, tucks his tablet, and holds the pedestal.

sentences.zh: 皇帝、皇后飲，殿下臣僚分班，教坊奏樂，皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: The emperor and empress drink; officials below the hall are dismissed by rank; the Music Office plays music; all bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor and empress drink; officials below are dismissed by formation; the Music Office plays; all bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 卒飲，皇帝、皇后授盞。

translations.literal: When drinking is finished, the emperor and empress hand back the cups.
translations.idiomatic: When they finish drinking, the emperor and empress hand back the cups.

sentences.zh: 引下殿，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: He is led down the hall; dancing bow; five bows.
translations.idiomatic: He is led down from the dais and performs the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，引出。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they are led out.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties and are led out.

sentences.zh: 臣僚進奉如儀，宣宴如儀。

translations.literal: Officials present tribute as in the ceremony; the banquet is proclaimed as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Officials present tribute as prescribed; the banquet is proclaimed as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 教坊、監盞、臣僚上殿祗候如儀。

translations.literal: The Music Office, cup-attendants, and officials ascend the hall and attend as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office, cup-attendants, and officials ascend the dais and attend as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 皇后進皇帝酒，殿上贊拜，侍臣僚皆拜。

translations.literal: The empress presents wine to the emperor; on the hall bowing is proclaimed; attending officials all bow.
translations.idiomatic: The empress presents wine to the emperor; bowing is proclaimed on the dais; all attending officials bow.

sentences.zh: 皇帝受盞，皆拜。

translations.literal: The emperor receives the cup; all bow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor receives the cup; all bow.

sentences.zh: 皇后坐，契丹舍人、漢人閣使殿上贊拜，皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: The empress is seated; a Khitan chamberlain and a Han gate commissioner on the hall proclaim bowing; all bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: The empress takes her seat; a Khitan chamberlain and a Han gate commissioner on the dais proclaim bowing; all bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 贊各就位。

translations.literal: "Each take your position" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to take their positions.

sentences.zh: 大臣進皇帝、皇后酒，行酒如儀。

translations.literal: A great minister presents wine to the emperor and empress; wine is served as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: A great minister presents wine to the emperor and empress; wine is served as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，行殽，行膳。

translations.literal: Wine is presented three rounds; dishes and full courses are served.
translations.idiomatic: Three rounds of wine are presented; dishes and full courses are served.

sentences.zh: 又進皇帝、皇后酒。

translations.literal: Wine is again presented to the emperor and empress.
translations.idiomatic: Wine is again presented to the emperor and empress.

sentences.zh: 酒再行，大饌入，行粥。

translations.literal: Wine is presented two more rounds; the grand feast enters; congee is served.
translations.idiomatic: Two more rounds of wine are presented; the grand feast is brought in; congee is served.

sentences.zh: 教坊致語，臣僚皆起立。

translations.literal: The Music Office delivers formal address; all officials rise and stand.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office delivers the formal address; all officials rise.

sentences.zh: 口號絕，贊拜，稱「萬歲」，引下殿謝宴，引出，皆如常儀。

translations.literal: When the shouted motto ends, bowing is proclaimed; they cry "Ten thousand years!"; they are led down the hall to thank for the banquet and led out—all as in the usual ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: When the shouted motto ends, they are acclaimed to bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"; they are led down to thank for the banquet and led out—all as in the usual ceremony.

sentences.zh: 進士接見儀：其日，舉人從時相至禦帳側，通名榜子與時相榜子同奏訖，時相朝見如常儀。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Receiving Jinshi Graduates: On the day, candidates follow the chief minister to the side of the imperial tent; the name lists are announced together with the chief minister's list and reported; the chief minister attends court as in the usual ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Receiving Jinshi Graduates: On the appointed day, candidates follow the chief minister to the side of the imperial tent; their name lists and the chief minister's list are announced and reported together; the chief minister attends court as usual.

sentences.zh: 畢，揖進士第一名以下丹墀內面殿鞠躬，通名，四拜。

translations.literal: When finished, the jinshi from the top candidate downward are motioned within the red steps to face the hall, bow with bodies bent, announce names, and perform four bows.
translations.idiomatic: When this is finished, the jinshi from the top candidate downward are motioned within the red steps to face the dais, bow with bodies bent, announce their names, and bow four times.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，皆退。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; all withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties and all withdraw.

sentences.zh: 若有進文字者，不退，奉卷平立。

translations.literal: If any present written compositions, they do not withdraw but hold the scroll and stand level.
translations.idiomatic: If any present written compositions, they do not withdraw but hold their scrolls and stand upright.

sentences.zh: 閣門奏受，跪左膝授訖，直起退。

translations.literal: The gate office reports acceptance; they kneel on the left knee and present it; when finished, they rise straight and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The gate office reports acceptance; they kneel on the left knee and present them; when finished, they rise and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished.

sentences.zh: 進士賜等甲敕儀：臣僚起居畢，讀卷官奏訖，於左方依等甲唱姓名序立，閣門交收敕牒。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Bestowing Jinshi Ranks and Edicts: When officials have finished paying respects, the reader of the examination rolls reports completion; on the left, names are called in order by rank and they stand in sequence; the gate office receives and takes charge of the edict documents.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Bestowing Jinshi Ranks and Edicts: When officials have finished the greeting, the reader of the examination rolls reports completion; on the left, names are called in order by rank and the graduates stand in sequence; the gate office receives the edict documents.

sentences.zh: 閣使奏引至丹墀，依等甲序立。

translations.literal: The gate commissioner reports and leads them to the red steps; they stand in order by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The gate commissioner reports and leads them to the red steps, where they stand in order by rank.

sentences.zh: 閣使稱「有敕」，再拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: The gate commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they perform a double bow and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: The gate commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they bow twice and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣敕「各依等甲賜卿敕牒一道，想宜知悉」，揖拜。

translations.literal: The chamberlain proclaims the edict: "Each of you is bestowed one edict document according to your rank; may you know this well"; they bow with a motion.
translations.idiomatic: The chamberlain proclaims the edict: "Each of you is bestowed one edict document according to your rank; may you know this well"; they bow with a motion.

sentences.zh: 各跪左膝，受敕訖，鞠躬，皆再拜。

translations.literal: Each kneels on the left knee, receives the edict; when finished, bows with body bent; all perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Each kneels on the left knee and receives the edict; when finished, they bow with body bent and all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 各祗候，分引左右相向侍立。

translations.literal: Each attends to duty; they are led out to left and right and stand facing one another in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Each attends to his duty; they are led to left and right and stand facing one another in attendance.

sentences.zh: 候奏事畢，引兩階上殿，就位，齊聲喏，賜坐。

translations.literal: When memorial business is finished, they are led up the hall by both stairways, take position, cry assent in unison, and are granted seats.
translations.idiomatic: When memorial business is finished, they are led onto the dais by both stairways, take their places, cry assent in unison, and are granted seats.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，起，聲喏如初。

translations.literal: Wine is presented three rounds; they rise and cry assent as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Three rounds of wine are presented; they rise and cry assent as before.

sentences.zh: 退揖出。

translations.literal: They withdraw with a bowing motion.
translations.idiomatic: They withdraw with a bowing motion.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished.

sentences.zh: 牌印郎君行酒，閣使勸飲。

translations.literal: A seal-bearing prince presents wine; the gate commissioner urges drinking.
translations.idiomatic: A seal-bearing prince presents wine; the gate commissioner urges them to drink.

sentences.zh: 進士賜章服儀：皇帝御殿，臣僚公服引進士入，東方面西，再拜，揖就丹墀位，面殿鞠躬。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Bestowing Jinshi Court Robes: The emperor presides in the hall; officials in formal dress lead the jinshi in; facing west on the east, they perform a double bow, are motioned to the red-step position, and bow to the hall with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Bestowing Jinshi Court Robes: The emperor presides in the hall; officials in formal dress lead the graduates in; on the east they face west, bow twice, are motioned to the red-step position, and bow toward the dais with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 閣使稱「有敕」，再拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: The gate commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they perform a double bow and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: The gate commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they bow twice and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣敕「各依等甲賜卿敕牒一道，兼賜章服，想宜知悉」，揖再拜。

translations.literal: The chamberlain proclaims the edict: "Each of you is bestowed one edict document according to your rank, together with court robes; may you know this well"; they bow with a motion and perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: The chamberlain proclaims the edict: "Each of you is bestowed one edict document according to your rank, together with court robes; may you know this well"; they bow with a motion and bow twice.

sentences.zh: 跪受敕訖，再拜。

translations.literal: They kneel, receive the edict; when finished, perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: They kneel and receive the edict; when finished, they bow twice.

sentences.zh: 退，引至章服所，更衣訖，揖復丹墀位，鞠躬。

translations.literal: They withdraw, are led to the robe office, change clothes; when finished, are motioned back to the red-step position and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: They withdraw, are led to the robe office, and change clothes; when finished, they are motioned back to the red-step position and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 贊謝恩，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: "Thank for grace" is proclaimed; dancing bow; five bows.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to thank for the imperial grace and perform the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 各祗候，殿東亭內序立。

translations.literal: Each attends to duty; they stand in order inside the eastern pavilion of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Each attends to his duty; they stand in order inside the eastern pavilion of the hall.

sentences.zh: 聲喏，坐。

translations.literal: They cry assent and sit.
translations.idiomatic: They cry assent and take their seats.

sentences.zh: 賜宴，簪花。

translations.literal: A banquet is bestowed; flowers are pinned in their caps.
translations.idiomatic: A banquet is bestowed and flowers are pinned in their caps.

sentences.zh: 宣閣使一員、閣門三人或二人勸飲終日。

translations.literal: One gate commissioner and three or two gate officers are dispatched to urge drinking throughout the day.
translations.idiomatic: One gate commissioner and three or two gate officers are dispatched to urge drinking throughout the day.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished.

sentences.zh: 宰相中謝儀：皇帝常服升殿坐，諸班起居如常儀。

translations.literal: Ceremony for a Chief Minister's Mid-Audience Thanks: The emperor in ordinary dress ascends the hall and is seated; all ranks pay respects as in the usual ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for a Chief Minister's Mid-Audience Thanks: The emperor in ordinary dress ascends the hall and takes his seat; all ranks perform the greeting as usual.

sentences.zh: 應坐臣僚上殿，其餘臣僚殿下東西侍立，皆如宋使初見之儀。

translations.literal: Officials who are to be seated ascend the hall; the remaining officials stand in attendance below the hall to east and west—all as in the ceremony for a Song envoy's first audience.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who are to be seated ascend the dais; the rest stand in attendance below to east and west—all as at a Song envoy's first audience.

sentences.zh: 引中謝官左入，至丹墀面西立。

translations.literal: The thanks-giving official is led in from the left to the red steps and stands facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The official offering thanks is led in from the left to the red steps and stands facing west.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿鞠躬，通新受具官姓名祗候中謝。

translations.literal: The chamberlain before the hall bows with body bent and announces the name of the newly appointed official attending to offer mid-audience thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The chamberlain before the dais bows with body bent and announces the name of the newly appointed official attending to offer mid-audience thanks.

sentences.zh: 宣徽殿上索通班舍人就贊禮位，贊某官至。

translations.literal: On the hall the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat summons the usher of the full formation to the acclamation position and proclaims that such-and-such official has arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On the dais the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat summons the usher of the full formation to the acclamation position and announces that such-and-such official has arrived.

sentences.zh: 宣徽贊通班舍人二人對立，揖中謝官鞠躬。

translations.literal: The Commissioner acclaims; two ushers of the full formation stand facing one another and motion the thanks-giving official to bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner acclaims; two ushers of the full formation stand facing one another and motion the thanks-giving official to bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 贊就拜位，舍人二人引面殿鞠躬。

translations.literal: "Take the bowing position" is proclaimed; two chamberlains lead him to face the hall and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to take the bowing position; two chamberlains lead him to face the dais and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，中謝官舞蹈，五拜，不出班，奏「聖躬萬福」。

translations.literal: "Bow" is proclaimed; the thanks-giving official performs the dancing bow with five bows, does not leave rank, and reports "May the sacred person enjoy ten thousand blessings."
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to bow; the thanks-giving official performs the dancing bow with five bows, does not leave formation, and declares "May His Majesty enjoy ten thousand blessings."

sentences.zh: 贊再拜。

translations.literal: "Double bow" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to bow twice.

sentences.zh: 揖出班跪，敘官，致詞訖，俯伏興，復位。

translations.literal: He is motioned out of rank to kneel, states his office, delivers his address; when finished, prostrates and rises, returns to position.
translations.idiomatic: He is motioned out of formation to kneel, states his office, and delivers his address; when finished, he prostrates and rises and returns to his place.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: "Bow" is proclaimed; dancing bow; five bows.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to bow and performs the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 又出班，中謝致詞如初儀，共十有七拜。

translations.literal: He again leaves rank; mid-audience thanks and address as in the first ceremony—in all seventeen bows.
translations.idiomatic: He again leaves formation; mid-audience thanks and address as at first—in all seventeen bows.

sentences.zh: 贊祗候，引右階上殿，就位。

translations.literal: "Attend to duty" is proclaimed; he is led up the hall by the right steps and takes position.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to attend to his duty and is led onto the dais by the right steps to take his place.

sentences.zh: 揖應坐臣僚聲喏坐。

translations.literal: Officials who are to be seated are motioned; they cry assent and sit.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who are to be seated are motioned; they cry assent and take their seats.

sentences.zh: 供奉官行酒，傳宣飲盡。

translations.literal: Palace service officers present wine; it is proclaimed that drinking is finished.
translations.idiomatic: Palace service officers present wine; drinking is proclaimed finished.

sentences.zh: 臣僚搢笏，執盞起，位後立飲；

translations.literal: Officials tuck their tablets, take up cups and rise, stand behind their places and drink;
translations.idiomatic: Officials tuck their tablets, take up their cups and rise, stand behind their places and drink;

sentences.zh: 置盞，出笏。

translations.literal: set down the cups and withdraw the tablets.
translations.idiomatic: set down their cups and withdraw their tablets.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，臣僚皆再拜。

translations.literal: "Bow" is proclaimed; all officials perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to bow; all officials bow twice.

sentences.zh: 贊各坐，搢笏，執盞，授供奉官盞。

translations.literal: "Each sit" is proclaimed; they tuck tablets, take up cups, and hand the cups to the palace service officers.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to take their seats, tuck their tablets, take up their cups, and hand them to the palace service officers.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，揖應坐臣僚聲喏立。

translations.literal: Wine is presented three rounds; officials who are to be seated are motioned; they cry assent and stand.
translations.idiomatic: Three rounds of wine are presented; officials who are to be seated are motioned; they cry assent and rise.

sentences.zh: 引中謝官右階下殿，至丹墀，面殿鞠躬。

translations.literal: The thanks-giving official is led down the hall by the right steps to the red steps and bows to the hall with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: The thanks-giving official is led down from the dais by the right steps to the red steps and bows toward the dais with body bent.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，舞蹈，五拜，引右出。

translations.literal: "Bow" is proclaimed; dancing bow; five bows; he is led out to the right.
translations.idiomatic: He is acclaimed to bow, performs the dancing bow with five bows, and is led out to the right.

sentences.zh: 臣僚皆出。

translations.literal: All officials go out.
translations.idiomatic: All officials withdraw.

sentences.zh: 丞相、樞密使同，餘官不升殿，賜酒，不帶節度使不通班，止通名，七拜。

translations.literal: The chief minister and the commissioner of military affairs are the same; remaining officials do not ascend the hall; wine is bestowed; those not bearing the title of military commissioner do not pass through the full formation but only have names announced—seven bows.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister and the commissioner of military affairs follow the same procedure; remaining officials do not ascend the dais; wine is bestowed; those who are not military commissioners do not pass through the full formation but only have their names announced—seven bows.

sentences.zh: 眾謝，班首一人出班中謝。

translations.literal: The multitude thanks; one person from the head of the rank leaves rank for mid-audience thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled officials thank; one person from the head of the formation leaves formation to offer mid-audience thanks.

sentences.zh: 拜表儀：其日，先於東上閣門陳設氈位，分引南北臣僚、諸國使副於氈位合班。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Presenting a Memorial Table: On the day, felt seats are first set out at the eastern upper gate office; southern and northern officials and envoys from all states are led separately to unite ranks at the felt seats.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Presenting a Memorial Table: On the appointed day, felt seats are first set out at the eastern upper gate office; officials from north and south and envoys from all states are led separately to unite in rank at the felt seats.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人二人舁表案，置班首前，揖鞠躬，再拜，平身。

translations.literal: Two interpreting chamberlains carry the memorial table, set it before the head of the rank, motion a bow with body bent, perform a double bow, and stand with bodies level.
translations.idiomatic: Two interpreting chamberlains carry the memorial table, set it before the head of the formation, motion a bow with body bent, bow twice, and stand upright.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人立案側，班首跪，搢笏，興，捧表，跪左膝，以表授中書舍人。

translations.literal: A Secretariat drafter stands at the side of the table; the head of the rank kneels, tucks his tablet, rises, holds the memorial, kneels on the left knee, and hands the memorial to the Secretariat drafter.
translations.idiomatic: A Secretariat drafter stands at the side of the table; the head of the formation kneels, tucks his tablet, rises, holds the memorial, kneels on the left knee, and hands it to the Secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: 出笏，就拜，興，再拜。

translations.literal: He withdraws his tablet, performs obeisance in place, rises, and performs a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: He withdraws his tablet, bows in place, rises, and bows twice.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人復置表案上。

translations.literal: The Secretariat drafter again sets the memorial on the table.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat drafter sets the memorial back on the table.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人舁表案於東上閣門入，卷班，分引出。

translations.literal: The interpreting chamberlains carry the memorial table in through the eastern upper gate office; ranks are rolled up; they are led out separately.
translations.idiomatic: The interpreting chamberlains carry the memorial table in through the eastern upper gate office; the formation is dismissed; they are led out separately.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished.

sentences.zh: 元日皇帝不御坐行此儀，余應上表有故皆仿此。

translations.literal: On New Year's Day, when the emperor does not take the imperial seat, this ceremony is performed; whenever memorial presentation is prevented for any reason, all follow this model.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day, when the emperor does not take the imperial seat, this ceremony is performed; whenever memorial presentation is prevented for any reason, the same procedure is followed.

sentences.zh: 賀生皇子儀：其日，奉先帝御容，設正殿，皇帝御八角殿升坐。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Congratulating on the Birth of a Prince: On the day, the late emperor's imperial portrait is displayed; the main hall is set out; the emperor presides in the octagonal hall and ascends to be seated.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Congratulating on the Birth of a Prince: On the appointed day, the late emperor's imperial portrait is displayed; the main hall is set out; the emperor presides in the octagonal hall and takes his seat.

sentences.zh: 聲警畢，北南宣徽使殿階上左右立，北南臣僚金冠盛服，合班入。

translations.literal: When the guard cry is finished, northern and southern Commissioners of the Palace Secretariat stand left and right on the hall steps; northern and southern officials in gold caps and full dress unite ranks and enter.
translations.idiomatic: When the guard cry is finished, northern and southern Commissioners of the Palace Secretariat stand to left and right on the hall steps; northern and southern officials in gold caps and full dress unite in rank and enter.

sentences.zh: 班首二人捧表立，讀表官先於左階上側立。

translations.literal: Two heads of the rank stand holding the memorial; the reader of the memorial stands beforehand on the upper side of the left steps.
translations.idiomatic: Two heads of the formation stand holding the memorial; the reader of the memorial stands beforehand on the upper side of the left steps.

sentences.zh: 二宣徽使東西階下殿受表，捧表者跪左膝授訖，就拜，興，再拜。

translations.literal: The two commissioners descend the hall by the east and west steps to receive the memorial; the memorial bearer kneels on the left knee and presents it; when finished, performs obeisance in place, rises, and performs a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: The two commissioners descend from the dais by the eastern and western steps to receive the memorial; the bearer kneels on the left knee and presents it; when finished, he bows in place, rises, and bows twice.

sentences.zh: 各祗候。

translations.literal: Each attends to duty.
translations.idiomatic: Each attends to his duty.

sentences.zh: 二宣徽使俱左階上授讀表官，讀訖，揖臣僚鞠躬。

translations.literal: Both commissioners ascend the left steps and hand the memorial to the reader; when the reading is finished, officials are motioned to bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: Both commissioners ascend the left steps and hand the memorial to the reader; when the reading is finished, officials are motioned to bow with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 引北面班首左階上殿，欄內稱賀訖，引左階下殿，復位，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The northern head of the rank is led up the hall by the left steps; inside the railing he offers congratulations; when finished, he is led down the left steps, returns to position, performs the dancing bow with five bows.
translations.idiomatic: The northern head of the formation is led onto the dais by the left steps; inside the railing he offers congratulations; when finished, he is led down the left steps, returns to his place, and performs the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 禮畢。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished.

sentences.zh: 賀祥瑞儀：聲警，北南臣僚金冠盛服，合班立。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Congratulating on Auspicious Omens: The guard cry; northern and southern officials in gold caps and full dress unite ranks and stand.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Congratulating on Auspicious Omens: The guard cry sounds; northern and southern officials in gold caps and full dress unite in rank and stand.

sentences.zh: 班首二人各奉表賀，北南宣徽使左階下殿受表，上殿授讀表大臣。

translations.literal: Two heads of the rank each hold memorials of congratulation; northern and southern commissioners descend the left steps to receive the memorials, ascend the hall, and hand them to the great minister who reads the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Two heads of the formation each hold memorials of congratulation; northern and southern commissioners descend the left steps to receive them, ascend the dais, and hand them to the great minister who reads the memorial.

sentences.zh: 讀訖，揖殿下臣僚鞠躬，五拜畢，鞠躬。

translations.literal: When the reading is finished, officials below the hall are motioned to bow with bodies bent; when five bows are finished, they bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading is finished, officials below the dais are motioned to bow with bodies bent; when five bows are finished, they bow with bodies bent again.

sentences.zh: 引班首二人左階上殿，欄內拜跪稱賀，致詞訖，引左階下殿，復位，五拜畢，鞠躬。

translations.literal: Two heads of the rank are led up the hall by the left steps; inside the railing they bow and kneel to offer congratulations and deliver an address; when finished, they are led down the left steps, return to position; when five bows are finished, they bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: Two heads of the formation are led onto the dais by the left steps; inside the railing they bow and kneel to offer congratulations and deliver an address; when finished, they are led down the left steps and return to their places; when five bows are finished, they bow with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 宣答、聽制訖，再拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: When the proclaimed response and listening to the edict are finished, they perform a double bow and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: When the proclaimed response and the hearing of the edict are finished, they bow twice and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 謝宣諭，五拜畢，各祗候，分班侍立。

translations.literal: They thank for the proclaimed instruction; when five bows are finished, each attends to duty; they are dismissed by rank and stand in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: They thank for the imperial instruction; when five bows are finished, each attends to his duty; they are dismissed by formation and stand in attendance.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，兩府奏事如常。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished; the two administrations report business as usual.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished; the two administrations report business as usual.

sentences.zh: 乾統六年，木葉山瑞雲見，始行此儀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiantong, an auspicious cloud appeared at Muye Mountain; this ceremony was first performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Qiantong, when an auspicious cloud appeared at Muye Mountain, this ceremony was first performed.

sentences.zh: 天慶元年，天雨谷，謝宣諭後，趙王進酒，教坊動樂，臣僚酒一行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqing, when grain rained from heaven, after thanks for the proclaimed instruction, the Prince of Zhao presented wine; the Music Office set music in motion; officials were served one round of wine.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqing, when grain rained from heaven, after thanks for the imperial instruction the Prince of Zhao presented wine; the Music Office struck up; officials were served one round of wine.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，奏事。

translations.literal: The ceremony is finished; memorial business is reported.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony is finished; memorial business is reported.

sentences.zh: 賀平難儀：皇帝、皇后升殿坐，北南臣僚並命婦合班，五拜。

translations.literal: Ceremony for Congratulating on the Suppression of Internal Disorder: The emperor and empress ascend the hall and are seated; northern and southern officials and titled ladies unite ranks and perform five bows.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremony for Congratulating on the Suppression of Internal Disorder: The emperor and empress ascend the hall and take their seats; northern and southern officials and titled ladies unite in rank and bow five times.

sentences.zh: 揖班首二人出班，俯跪，搢笏，執表，舁案近前。

translations.literal: Two heads of the rank are motioned out of rank; they prostrate and kneel, tuck their tablets, hold the memorial, and carry the table forward.
translations.idiomatic: Two heads of the formation are motioned out of rank; they prostrate and kneel, tuck their tablets, hold the memorial, and carry the table forward.

sentences.zh: 閣使受表，置案上，皆再拜。

translations.literal: The gate commissioner receives the memorial and sets it on the table; all perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: The gate commissioner receives the memorial and sets it on the table; all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人二人舁案，左階上殿，置露臺上。

translations.literal: Two interpreting chamberlains carry the table, ascend the hall by the left steps, and set it on the exposed terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Two interpreting chamberlains carry the table, ascend the dais by the left steps, and set it on the upper terrace.

sentences.zh: 讀表官受，入讀表。

translations.literal: The reader of the memorial receives it and enters to read the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The reader of the memorial receives it and enters to read it.

sentences.zh: 對禦讀訖，臣僚殿下五拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: When the reading facing the throne is finished, officials below the hall perform five bows and bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading before the throne is finished, officials below the dais bow five times and bow with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 引班首二人左右階上殿，欄內並立。

translations.literal: Two heads of the rank are led up the hall by the left and right steps and stand together inside the railing.
translations.idiomatic: Two heads of the formation are led onto the dais by the left and right steps and stand together inside the railing.

sentences.zh: 先引北面班首少前，跪致詞訖，退復褥位。

translations.literal: First the northern head of the rank is led slightly forward, kneels and delivers an address; when finished, he withdraws and returns to his cushion seat.
translations.idiomatic: First the northern head of the formation is led slightly forward, kneels and delivers an address; when finished, he withdraws to his cushioned place.

sentences.zh: 次引南面班首亦如之。

translations.literal: Next the southern head of the rank is led forward in the same manner.
translations.idiomatic: Next the southern head of the formation is led forward in the same way.

sentences.zh: 畢，分引左右階下殿，復位，五拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: When finished, they are led separately down the left and right steps, return to position, perform five bows, and bow with bodies bent.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, they are led down the left and right steps separately, return to their places, bow five times, and bow with bodies bent.

sentences.zh: 宣徽稱「有敕」，再拜，宣答「內難已平，與公等內外同慶。

translations.literal: The Commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they perform a double bow; the proclaimed response is: "The internal disorder has been pacified; within and without, let us celebrate together with you."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner announces "There is an edict"; they bow twice; the response is proclaimed: "The internal disorder has been pacified; let us celebrate together with you, within and without."

sentences.zh: 」謝宣諭，五拜。

translations.literal: " They thank for the proclaimed instruction with five bows.
translations.idiomatic: " They thank for the imperial instruction with five bows.

sentences.zh: 卷班。

translations.literal: Ranks are rolled up.
translations.idiomatic: The formation is dismissed.

sentences.zh: 臣僚從皇帝，命婦從皇后，詣皇太后殿，見先帝御容，陪位，皆再拜。

translations.literal: Officials follow the emperor; titled ladies follow the empress; they proceed to the Empress Dowager's hall, view the late emperor's imperial portrait, take accompanying positions, and all perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Officials follow the emperor; titled ladies follow the empress; they proceed to the Empress Dowager's hall, view the late emperor's portrait, take accompanying positions, and all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 皇太后正坐，稱賀，共十拜，並引上殿，賜宴如儀。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager sits formally; congratulations are offered—ten bows in all; they are all led up the hall and granted a banquet as in the ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager sits formally; congratulations are offered—ten bows in all; they are all led onto the dais and granted a banquet as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 平難之儀，道宗清寧九年，太叔重元謀逆，仁懿太后親率衛士與逆黨戰。

translations.literal: As for the ceremony for pacifying disorder: In the ninth year of Qingning under Emperor Daozong, the emperor's uncle Chongyuan plotted rebellion; Empress Dowager Renyi personally led guards to fight the rebel faction.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony for pacifying disorder was instituted in the ninth year of Qingning under Emperor Daozong, when the emperor's uncle Chongyuan plotted rebellion and Empress Dowager Renyi personally led the guards against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 事平，因制此儀。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, this ceremony was therefore instituted.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, this ceremony was instituted.

sentences.zh: 正旦朝賀儀：臣僚並諸國使昧爽入朝，奏「班齊」。

translations.literal: New Year's Day Court Congratulations Ceremony: Officials and envoys from all states enter court at daybreak and report "Ranks are assembled."
translations.idiomatic: New Year's Day Court Congratulations Ceremony: Officials and envoys from all states attend court at daybreak and report that the ranks are formed.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升殿坐，契丹舍人殿上通訖，引契丹臣僚東洞門入，引漢人臣僚並諸國使西洞門入。

translations.literal: The emperor ascends the hall and is seated; when the Khitan chamberlain on the hall has finished announcing, Khitan officials are led in through the east tunnel gate; Han officials and envoys from all states are led in through the west tunnel gate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascends the hall and takes his seat; when the Khitan chamberlain on the dais has finished announcing names, Khitan officials are led in through the east tunnel gate and Han officials and envoys from all states through the west tunnel gate.

sentences.zh: 合班，舞蹈，五拜，鞠躬，平身。

translations.literal: They unite ranks, perform the dancing bow with five bows, bow with bodies bent, and stand with bodies level.
translations.idiomatic: They unite in rank, perform the dancing bow with five bows, bow with bodies bent, and stand upright.

sentences.zh: 引親王東階上殿，欄內褥位俯伏跪，自通全銜臣某等祝壽訖，伏興，退，引東階下殿，復位，舞蹈，五拜畢，鞠躬。

translations.literal: A prince is led up the hall by the east steps; inside the railing at his cushion seat he prostrates and kneels, announces his full title himself: "Your servants such-and-such wish long life"; when finished, he rises from prostration, withdraws, is led down the east steps, returns to position; when five bows of the dancing bow are finished, he bows with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: A prince is led onto the dais by the eastern steps; inside the railing at his cushioned place he prostrates and kneels and announces his full title: "Your servants such-and-such wish long life"; when finished, he rises, withdraws, is led down the eastern steps, returns to his place, and when five bows of the dancing bow are finished bows with body bent.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使殿上鞠躬，奏「臣宣答」，稱「有敕」，班首以下聽制訖，再拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat on the hall bows with body bent and reports "Your servant proclaims the response"; announces "There is an edict"; from the head of the rank downward, when listening to the edict is finished, they perform a double bow and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: On the dais the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat bows with body bent and reports "Your servant proclaims the response"; announces "There is an edict"; from the head of the formation downward, when the edict has been heard, they bow twice and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 宣徽傳宣云：履新之慶，與公等同之。

translations.literal: The commissioner transmits the proclamation: "The joy of treading the new—let us share it with you."
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner transmits the proclamation: "The joy of the new year—let us share it with you."

sentences.zh: 舍人贊謝宣諭，拜，舞蹈，五拜。

translations.literal: The chamberlain proclaims thanks for the instruction; they bow, perform the dancing bow with five bows.
translations.idiomatic: The chamberlain proclaims thanks for the instruction; they bow and perform the dancing bow with five bows.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，分班引出，引班首西階上殿，奏表目訖，教坊起居，賀，十二拜，畢，贊各祗候。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they are dismissed by rank and led out; the head of the rank is led up the hall by the west steps and reports the memorial lists; when finished, the Music Office pays respects, offers congratulations, and performs twelve bows; when finished, "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties, dismissed by formation, and led out; the head of the formation is led onto the dais by the western steps to present the memorial lists; when finished, the Music Office performs the greeting, offers congratulations, and bows twelve times; when finished, they are acclaimed to attend to their duties.

sentences.zh: 引契丹、漢人臣僚並諸國使東西洞門入，合班，再拜。

translations.literal: Khitan and Han officials and envoys from all states are led in through the east and west tunnel gates; they unite ranks and perform a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan and Han officials and envoys from all states are led in through the eastern and western tunnel gates, unite in rank, and bow twice.

sentences.zh: 贊進酒，引親王東階上殿，就欄內褥位，搢笏，執臺盞，進酒訖，退，復褥位，置臺，出笏，少前俯跪，自通全銜臣某等謹進千萬歲壽酒。

translations.literal: "Present wine" is proclaimed; a prince is led up the hall by the east steps to his cushion seat inside the railing; he tucks his tablet, holds a pedestal cup, and presents wine; when finished, he withdraws and returns to his cushion seat, sets down the pedestal, withdraws his tablet, moves slightly forward and prostrates kneeling, and announces his full title himself: "Your servants such-and-such respectfully present wine for ten thousand years of longevity."
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to present wine; a prince is led onto the dais by the eastern steps to his cushioned place inside the railing; he tucks his tablet, takes up a pedestal cup, and presents wine; when finished, he withdraws to his cushioned place, sets down the pedestal, withdraws his tablet, moves slightly forward and kneels prostrate, and announces his full title: "Your servants such-and-such respectfully present wine for ten thousand years of longevity."

sentences.zh: 俯伏興，退，復褥位，與殿下臣僚皆再拜，鞠躬。

translations.literal: He rises from prostration, withdraws, returns to his cushion seat; he and officials below the hall all perform a double bow and bow with body bent.
translations.idiomatic: He rises from prostration, withdraws to his cushioned place; he and officials below all bow twice and bow with body bent.

sentences.zh: 俟宣徽使殿上鞠躬，奏「臣宣答」，稱「有敕」，親王以下再拜如初儀。

translations.literal: They wait until the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat on the hall bows with body bent and reports "Your servant proclaims the response" and announces "There is an edict"; the prince and those below perform a double bow as in the first ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: They wait until on the dais the Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat bows with body bent, reports "Your servant proclaims the response," and announces "There is an edict"; the prince and those below bow twice as at first.

sentences.zh: 傳宣云：「飲公等壽酒，與公等內外同慶。

translations.literal: The transmitted proclamation says: "Drink your longevity wine; within and without, let us celebrate together with you."
translations.idiomatic: The transmitted proclamation says: "Drink your longevity wine; let us celebrate together with you, within and without."

sentences.zh: 」舍人贊謝宣諭如初。

translations.literal: " The chamberlain proclaims thanks for the instruction as at first.
translations.idiomatic: " The chamberlain proclaims thanks for the instruction as before.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties.

sentences.zh: 親王搢笏，執臺，殿下臣僚分班。

translations.literal: The prince tucks his tablet and holds the pedestal; officials below the hall are dismissed by rank.
translations.idiomatic: The prince tucks his tablet and holds the pedestal; officials below are dismissed by formation.

sentences.zh: 皇帝飲酒，教坊奏樂，殿上下臣僚皆拜，稱「萬歲」。

translations.literal: The emperor drinks; the Music Office plays music; officials above and below the hall all bow and cry "Ten thousand years!"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor drinks; the Music Office plays; all officials on and below the dais bow and exclaim "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties.

sentences.zh: 樂止，教坊再拜。

translations.literal: Music stops; the Music Office performs a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: The music stops; the Music Office bows twice.

sentences.zh: 皇帝卒飲，親王進受戔，復褥位，置臺戔，出笏。

translations.literal: When the emperor finishes drinking, the prince advances to receive the cup-stand, returns to his cushion seat, sets down the pedestal and stand, and withdraws his tablet.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor finishes drinking, the prince advances to receive the cup-stand, returns to his cushioned place, sets down the pedestal and stand, and withdraws his tablet.

sentences.zh: 揖臣僚合班，引親王東階下殿，復位，鞠躬，再拜。

translations.literal: Officials are motioned to unite ranks; the prince is led down the hall by the east steps, returns to position, bows with body bent, and performs a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Officials are motioned to unite in rank; the prince is led down from the dais by the eastern steps, returns to his place, bows with body bent, and bows twice.

sentences.zh: 贊各祗候，分班引出。

translations.literal: "Each attend to duty" is proclaimed; they are dismissed by rank and led out.
translations.idiomatic: They are acclaimed to attend to their duties, dismissed by formation, and led out.

sentences.zh: 皇帝起，詣皇太后殿，臣僚並諸國使皆從。

translations.literal: The emperor rises and proceeds to the Empress Dowager's hall; officials and envoys from all states all follow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rises and proceeds to the Empress Dowager's hall; officials and envoys from all states follow.

sentences.zh: 皇太后升殿，皇帝東方側坐。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall; the emperor is seated to the side on the east.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager ascends the hall; the emperor sits to one side on the east.

sentences.zh: 引契丹、漢人臣僚並諸國使兩洞門入，合班稱賀，進酒，皆如皇帝之儀。

translations.literal: Khitan and Han officials and envoys from all states are led in through both tunnel gates; they unite ranks and offer congratulations and present wine—all as in the emperor's ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan and Han officials and envoys from all states are led in through both tunnel gates; they unite in rank to offer congratulations and present wine—all as in the emperor's ceremony.

sentences.zh: 畢，引出。

translations.literal: When finished, they are led out.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, they are led out.

sentences.zh: 教坊入，起居，進酒亦如之。

translations.literal: The Music Office enters, pays respects, and presents wine likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The Music Office enters, performs the greeting, and presents wine likewise.

sentences.zh: 皇太后宣答稱「聖旨」。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager's proclaimed response is called "Imperial edict."
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager's proclaimed response is termed "Imperial edict."

sentences.zh: 契丹班謝宣宴，上殿就位立。

translations.literal: The Khitan rank thanks for the proclaimed banquet and ascends the hall to take position and stand.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan formation thanks for the proclaimed banquet and ascends the dais to take their places.

sentences.zh: 漢人臣僚並諸國使東洞門入，丹墀東方，面西鞠躬，舍人鞠躬，通文武百僚宰臣某已下謝宣宴，再拜；

translations.literal: Han officials and envoys from all states enter the east tunnel gate, stand on the east of the red steps facing west and bow with bodies bent; the chamberlain bows with body bent and announces that civil and military officials and chief ministers of such-and-such rank and below thank for the proclaimed banquet; they perform a double bow;
translations.idiomatic: Han officials and envoys from all states enter through the east tunnel gate, stand on the eastern red steps facing west and bow with bodies bent; the chamberlain bows with body bent and announces that civil and military officials and chief ministers from such-and-such rank downward thank for the banquet; they bow twice;

sentences.zh: 出班致詞訖，退復位，舞蹈，五拜，贊各上殿祗候，引宰臣以下並諸國使副，方裀朵殿臣僚，西階上殿就位立。

translations.literal: they leave rank and deliver an address; when finished, withdraw and return to position; dancing bow; five bows; "Each ascend the hall and attend" is proclaimed; chief ministers and below, envoys and deputies from all states, and officials of the square-mat banquet in the Duo Hall are led up the hall by the west steps to take position and stand.
translations.idiomatic: they leave formation and deliver an address; when finished, they withdraw and return to their places; they perform the dancing bow with five bows; they are acclaimed to ascend the dais and attend; chief ministers and below, envoys and deputies from all states, and officials of the square-mat banquet in the Duo Hall are led onto the dais by the western steps to take their places.

sentences.zh: 不應坐臣僚並於西洞門出。

translations.literal: Officials not to be seated all go out through the west tunnel gate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials who are not to be seated all withdraw through the west tunnel gate.

sentences.zh: 二人監盞，教坊再拜。

translations.literal: Two cup-attendants supervise; the Music Office performs a double bow.
translations.idiomatic: Two cup-attendants supervise; the Music Office bows twice.

sentences.zh: 贊各上階下殿謝宴，如皇太后生辰儀。

translations.literal: "Each ascend the steps, descend the hall, and thank for the banquet" is proclaimed—as in the Empress Dowager's birthday ceremony.
